meta.name: boardroom
meta.description: /cs:boardroom <brief> — 6-phase multi-role deliberation across the C-suite with Phase 2 isolation, critic pre-screen, and synthesis. Outputs a board memo. Use when a decision spans multiple executive domains — e.g. a pricing change touching finance, positioning, and product, or a raise-vs-cut runway call.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 组织六阶段高管辩论,自动生成董事会决策备忘录
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正为跨部门重大决策发愁,想要多角度高管视角的权衡。
copy.tagline_en: Run a six-phase executive debate and get a board-ready decision memo
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you face complex cross-functional decisions and want a structured multi-role executive review.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会模拟多位高管角色组成的董事会,对战略简报进行 6 阶段审议:独立表态、交叉质询、魔鬼代言人挑战,最后综合成董事会备忘录。产出含推荐、投票、异议和成功标准的备忘录文件。
howto.when: 当决策涉及多个高管领域(如定价、融资等),或你直接输入 `/cs:boardroom <brief>` 命令时触发。

say.text: 用 /cs:boardroom 审议定价变更简报
say.note: 触发完整董事会审议并产出备忘录

say.text: 对裁员方案简报运行董事会审议
say.note: 各高管角色独立表态后再交叉质询

say.text: 请为融资决策生成一份董事会备忘录
say.note: Claude 会按 6 阶段流程综合出决策建议

howto.what_en: Claude simulates a board of executives to review a strategy brief in 6 stages: independent thinking, cross-examination, devil's advocate, and synthesis. It outputs a board memo with recommendation, votes, dissents, and kill criteria.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you run /cs:boardroom with a brief, or when a decision spans multiple executive domains (e.g., pricing, funding, layoffs).

say_en.text: Run /cs:boardroom on the pricing change brief
say_en.note: Runs the full board process and outputs a memo.

say_en.text: Hold a boardroom review on the layoff plan brief
say_en.note: Each role speaks independently before cross-examination.

say_en.text: Please generate a board memo for the funding decision
say_en.note: Claude synthesizes a recommendation via the 6-phase flow.
